vo: Day 1: my first container of kids' toys hits the port.
Then customs. My broker: it's on hold, I need the certificate data.
I only have a lab report. Imported toys now need certificate data eFiled at entry.
So I build it: product, each rule, factory, lab, records contact.
Blocked right now? Forward the notice. Get your gap list in twenty-four hours.
caps: Say I'm a seller. My toys arrive in container KID-24-BLUE.
The truck stops at the gate.
Imported toys: certificate data eFiled at entry.
From my file, for the entry filing.
